items.name: Mattresses
items.description: Orthopedic, memory foam and hybrid mattresses engineered for restorative sleep. Available in single, queen and king sizes with firmness options suited to family bedrooms and hotel-grade nightly turnover alike.

items.name: Bedsheets
items.description: Fine cotton and premium cotton-blend bedsheets in timeless weaves — crisp percale for hotel freshness, or soft sateen for a cosier home feel, in a refined, easy-to-coordinate colour palette.

items.name: Duvets
items.description: Plush, temperature-balanced duvets and comforters in a range of warmth ratings, from light all-season options for guest rooms to heavier fills for Pokhara's cooler winter months at home.

items.name: Pillows & Covers
items.description: Supportive pillows in soft, medium and firm fills, paired with elegant covers — sized and finished to hotel housekeeping standards or a softer, personal touch for the home.

items.name: Curtains
items.description: Statement drapery in silk, velvet and linen, made to measure for every window — blackout linings available for guest rooms, and lighter sheers for airy living spaces at home.

items.name: Curtain Tracks & Rods
items.description: Motorised and manual tracks, poles and finials in brushed brass, matte black and wood finishes — sized for large hotel window walls or fitted neatly into a single home window.

items.name: Carpets
items.description: Hand-selected wall-to-wall and area carpets in durable, high-traffic weaves for hotel corridors and lobbies, or softer pile options that anchor a living room at home.

items.name: Blinds
items.description: Roller, roman and venetian blinds in blackout, dim-out and light-filtering fabrics — balancing natural light with privacy for both guest rooms and home offices.

items.name: Rugs
items.description: Artisanal area rugs in wool, jute and synthetic blends, chosen for character underfoot in a lobby seating area or as the finishing layer in a family living room.

items.name: Sofa & Cushion Covers
items.description: Tailored, washable sofa and cushion covers that refresh a lobby lounge or living room instantly — a practical way for hotels to protect upholstery between deep cleans.

items.name: Table Linen & Kitchen Textiles
items.description: Tablecloths, runners, napkins and kitchen textiles in durable, easy-care fabrics — set for a hotel breakfast room or dressed simply for everyday family dining.

items.name: Towels
items.description: Spa-grade, highly absorbent cotton towels in bath, hand and face sizes, woven for the repeated wash cycles of hotel laundry while staying soft enough for daily home use.

items.name: Bath Robes & Slippers
items.description: Waffle-weave and terry bath robes with matching slippers — a signature guest amenity for resorts and boutique hotels, also available for a spa-style touch at home.

items.name: Hotel Furnishings
items.description: Complete furnishing packages for hotels and resorts — mattresses to linens, curtains to carpets — coordinated by room type and delivered turnkey, floor by floor.
